fault: ops_actions with no action (or session_only only) fails: Object of type object is not JSON serializable
set_option settings.scale rejects HO with must be a whole number; the tool does not list that JMRI's index is wanted (6 for HO)
set_option cannot set the railroad name: railroad.name is refused on a blank file and no other setup action takes it
workaround: Stage 5 tries set_train_manifest per train; else the JMRI GUI

fault: ops_list has no type that shows buildOptions, router or settings values; only a plan diff shows them
A plan that creates many findings prints every finding in full (78 load-no-train/load-no-track entries twice: in the plan and in the audit)
The first ops_apply on a blank folder returns an empty backup name
add_track with hold_custom true and no schedule is refused (Schedule options need a schedule on the track), so a spur cannot be created held before its schedule exists
workaround: Add the schedule first; set hold_custom with update_track

fault: ops_list tracks omits locomotive types from the types field: Diesel-only engine tracks show types [] and yard tracks with Diesel show none; only the plan diff shows locoType
add_route stop fields pickups and drops given as the strings yes/no are ignored without error; the diff shows both yes
workaround: Pass JSON true/false and read the diff

fault: add_train refuses engine_road and a new engine_model until an engine of that road and model exists, so train power cannot be declared before the roster
setup_interchange set_out_by, pulled_by and destinations refuse the {option, names} shape that add_track uses for the same lists; they take a plain list, and destinations has no way to say All
workaround: Pass a plain list; leave destinations unset

fault: ops_list trains shows no description, departure time or comment

add_industry names the schedule <spur> Schedule and a same-named schedule returns the existing one, so two industries with a spur called Chemical Unload would share one schedule and the second industry's lines would be dropped without warning
workaround: add_schedule under a unique name then add_track naming it

fault: add_industry has no pick up or set out list fields, so a spur restricted to one train needs a second update_track action
